name: gameserver-interface
description: Web-Panel zur Verwaltung von Gameserver-Instanzen auf Linux-Hosts

scripts.build: npm run build -w @gsp/shared && npm run build -w @gsp/server && npm run build -w @gsp/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @gsp/server" "npm run dev -w @gsp/web"
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
